verdict.rationale: Bruno ships a built-in assistant, Bruno AI. Its AI Chat Sidebar works from anywhere in the workspace. You describe what you need and it writes pre/post-request scripts, tests and docs for you to review and accept, and it can build a complete working App from the open request or collection. It runs on your own key (BYOK) with OpenAI-compatible and local providers. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's quality, evidence of multi-step autonomous action inside the app (e.g., running requests or restructuring collections on its own rather than generating code for review).
